messages:
Maya: quick q — opened a small hotfix PR that tweaks router/service.go and also touches k8s overlays. who can actually approve the k8s bits? CODEOWNERS looks a bit fuzzy here. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/4721

Jamal: pinged. which paths exactly? if overlays/prod is modified, that usually falls under eng-infra. router/service.go is eng-platform. both teams have entries in CODEOWNERS AFAIK.

Maya: files are: `pkg/router/service.go` and `k8s/overlays/prod/ingress.yaml` — tiny change in service: change route priority for /health. ingress tweak adds a header for health checks.

Priya: short and mechanical. but since both dirs touched, reviewers set by CODEOWNERS might only pick one team. CI will require 2 approvals for PROD overlays by policy.

Alex: FYI the repo-level `CODEOWNERS` currently has these lines:```/pkg/router/ @eng-platform @lina
/k8s/overlays/prod/ @eng-infra
```so automated assignment will only tag one owner depending on path. If the overlay bit is matched, it should tag eng-infra.

Maya: thanks. so should I explicitly @eng-platform in the PR description to get both?

Lina: I can review the router change and sign off, but infra needs to eyeball the ingress header change. @eng-infra can you take a look?

Jamal: tagging infra now — @Priya can you confirm infra approval policy on small header additions? is 1 infra approval enough or do we need infra + platform always for cross-area PRs?

Priya: policy: cross-area touches don't always require both if one owner explicitly approves and an owner from the other area adds a comment saying they defer. But for overlays/prod we still need an infra approval because it's a production k8s manifest. so infra person must click approve in GitHub.

CI-bot: Checks ✅ — unit tests: pass, e2e: ok (flaky flagged but non-blocking), image build: success. Required reviewers: 1 infra approval, 1 platform approval.

Maya: ok i'll add @lina and @Priya to the reviewers and add a short blurb: "router change safe, ingress header only affects k8s health check path, no rollout traffic change"

Lina: reviewed and left a tiny comment about logging, not blocking. Approving once comment addressed. :+1:

Priya: infra looked — ingress change is fine. approving now.

Alex: since infra approved, and Lina is good, you should be able to merge once Lina marks approved. Do we want a canary rollout? This is safe to immediate rollout but up to Maya.

Maya: will do a 10% canary for 30 minutes, then scale. merging after Lina approves. thanks all.

Lina: approved and tiny fix pushed. merged. :tada:

Maya: merged and canary started. will report if anything odd. thx everyone.

CI-bot: Deployment pipeline started: canary(10%) -> monitor(30m) -> promote. Logs: https://logs.rw/ingress/4721

Jamal: nice, clean coordination. filing a tiny follow-up to adjust CODEOWNERS maybe to include `/k8s/overlays/*` mapping to both teams for these cross-cutting infra/platform files.

Priya: +1 on updating CODEOWNERS to reduce manual pings. but keep prod overlays conservative (infra required).

Maya: noted — opening a follow-up PR to tweak CODEOWNERS mapping after this stabilizes.
